hooks.command: python -c "import sys; exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else 1)" && pip install -e '.[dev]' -q 2>/dev/null; echo '{"systemMessage": "Environment: Python '$(python --version 2>&1 | cut -d" " -f2)' | ruff '$(ruff --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f2 || echo N/A)' | pytest ready"}'
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.py$' && ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" && ruff format --quiet "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

KB=$(cat kb/sessions/planning.state.json 2>/dev/null; cat kb/sessions/dev-sqe.state.json 2>/dev/null; cat kb/sessions/pre-pr.state.json 2>/dev/null) && LEDGER=$(tail -10 kb/ledger/ledger.jsonl 2>/dev/null) && GIT=$(git diff --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null | tail -5) && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreCompact", "additionalContext": "KB_STATE: %s RECENT_LEDGER: %s GIT_STATUS: %s"}}' "$KB" "$LEDGER" "$GIT"
echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: If meaningful work was done, run the appropriate handoff skill before ending (CLAUDE.md Section 14)."}'
